cases.proves_bugs: BUG-861 (the one-drawing, real-mouse pick half only: REDO survives U and a real pit pick, five times in a fresh AutoCAD; the right-click CE menu half is not covered)
cases.title: REDO still works after U and a real-mouse pick of a pit, five times in a row (no runner read between U and REDO)
cases.expected: First a control round with no pick (draw a line, U, REDO: 'Everything has been redone'). Then five rounds: draw a line, U, click the pit P3 with the real mouse, wait 12 seconds, REDO: the command line says 'Everything has been redone' every time, never 'Nothing to redo'. After the rounds, one more click on the same point selects pit 109D56 (proof the click picks the pit). Between U and REDO the runner reads nothing from AutoCAD.
cases.why_not_unit: Whether REDO survives depends on what CE does in the seconds after a pick (the Inspector refresh) inside a real AutoCAD undo stack.
not_automated: The right-click CE menu half of BUG-861 and BUG-416 (the right-click menu is not read yet), and a second open drawing.

The click between U and REDO is a blind click (stored view, no hit proof, by design: any read of AutoCAD between U and REDO loses REDO by itself). That the click selected the pit is proved once, after the five rounds, by a second click at the same pixel and a pick-first read.
A pick made by the driver's typed LISP (v2 pick-first) or with the runner's usual proof reads is NOT used: those routes lose REDO even for a plain line.
